headline: Chile Presidential Candidate Kast Begins Official Visit to Vietnam Ahead of APEC
summary: Chilean political figure Jose Antonio Kast arrived in Vietnam for official state meetings with General Secretary To Lam. The delegation will focus on bilateral trade expansion prior to attending the APEC summit in China.
why: Vietnam and Chile share strong commercial linkages through the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP).

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: High-level bilateral diplomatic missions strengthen trans-Pacific trade and investment frameworks.
